name: spinlings
description: A creature card game above your prompt. Wild creatures, Rivals and other players' teams come to battle while Claude works. Catch, fuse, trade and gift one-of-a-kind cards.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: The Spinlings server this mod talks to, and the only host it ever contacts. Must be https (http is allowed for localhost and 127.0.0.1).

world.title: World
world.description: Where you play: online (the default: trade, duel and climb the boards with other players) or offline (on this machine only). /spin world switches any time; each world keeps its own collection.
